evidence: Phone area code (276) is Virginia, flagged as a possible relocated personal number per task brief.

Google Business Profile public page lists service area entirely in Florida: Cleveland, North Port, Punta Gorda, Port Charlotte, Lake Suzy (34269), Charlotte Harbor, Deep Creek (33983), Harbour Heights (33983), FL, USA.

A Google Business post on the same profile (about 4 years old) states the business 'moved to the Punta Gorda and Port Charlotte area', explaining the mismatch between the Virginia-area-code phone number (likely a personal number kept after relocating) and the current Florida service area.
A newer Google Business post (about 10 months old) states 'Veteran owned and operated.'

A second real phone number, 910-399-8707 (North Carolina area code), is printed on the company truck in one of the downloaded photos, suggesting the business previously operated out of NC/VA before settling in the Port Charlotte/Punta Gorda, FL area. Not used as the site's contact number since (276) 345-6220 is the number on the current, verified, claimed Google Business Profile.
